0.content:
Xiangling of Wanmin Restaurant is one of the few people Xinyan can talk to freely. Xinyan visits for late-night meals and chats into the night. She deliberately eats every experimental dish that others flee from, because the "taste bud explosion" sparks musical ideas, and she calls Xiangling the rock star of the culinary world. Xiangling says Xinyan enjoys nine out of ten of them. Xiangling is less sure "that dish rocked!" is a compliment.

In a 2.8 event mirage, Xiangling and Yun Jin hid in the dark in Xinyan's house to throw her a surprise birthday party; Xinyan says this really happened. Xiangling gave her a jade pendant she had made herself, to hang on the guitar Xinyan pampers every day. Xiangling also delivered Beidou's gifts: a custom dagger and a foreign score. Xiangling packed her a good-luck lunch for her trip to Inazuma.

1.content:
Yun Jin, the star of the Yun-Han Opera Troupe, is secretly devoted to rock. She attends Xinyan's shows at least three times a week, however busy she is, and Xinyan asks people to keep it secret. The troupe's elders disapprove of rock, so Yun Jin tells them she is visiting "Xingyan", the accomplished adopted daughter of a Fan Er'ye, to discuss opera. When Yun Jin first visited Xinyan's spotless home, Xinyan feared the contrast would put her off. It only made Yun Jin a bigger fan.

Xinyan uses Yun Jin's fandom to win arguments. She told a disapproving neighbour that even Liyue's most famous opera singer listens to her "boorish" music. In 3.4 (limited) she suggested Yun Jin and a commissioned song for the Lantern Rite concert. Yun Jin's family made her gold hairpins and iron hair ties for her birthday, to Xinyan's disbelief.

In a May 2025 mail Yun Jin said Xinyan was now holding concerts in Fontaine. Yun Jin left her stage to Yunning so she could attend them, and proposed a birthday gathering in Fontaine with Xinyan and the Traveler.

2.content:
Xinyan and Beidou are both blunt and big-hearted and get on great. The Crux's adventures inspired a song that sailors now join in on after its first line, and Xinyan says it is fast becoming a sea shanty. Beidou says her crew loves Xinyan's rock 'n' roll; the two have much in common, but not musical taste.

Beidou ferried Xinyan to Inazuma for the Iridescence Tour and handed her a bag of Mora before she disembarked (2.2 limited event). She put Xinyan in charge of the music at her "Drink-Till-You-Sink Champion-Ship" party, where Xinyan met Kazuha. At Lantern Rite 2.4 (limited) Xinyan joined the Alcor's festival feast and a salvage run against Treasure Hoarders; she was careful not to set the boat on fire.

3.comment: Xinyan: The Millelith and the friends of rock
3.content:
Xinyan's makeshift stages tend to burn down halfway through a show. After many warnings the Millelith stepped up patrols to stop her. She usually won the battle of wits, finding a spot and building a stage at frightening speed. Many guards became fans, "friends of rock", and leaked their patrol plans to her; one, Kun, openly urges visitors to see her shows. Since nobody was ever harmed, the Millelith adopted a "one eye open, one eye shut" approach.

She wrote to the Ministry of Civil Affairs, and the Tianquan amended the rules to designate performance spots available by application. Xinyan still finds it a hassle, but better than being harangued. Her official introduction describes Millelith chasing her for a "fire code violation" as she slips away after a show.

4.content:
Her hand-made instrument started as a copy of a Fontaine rock instrument and quickly stopped looking like one. It resembles a square ruan. A crescent axe-blade on the tail makes it a weapon in a pinch. It is wired to her Vision to spew flames and sparks, and it can burn itself up rather than fall into the wrong hands. She calls it a guitar or a lyre; Beidou calls it her "axe". She wants a cool name and has tried "The Fyre Lyre", "The Jadebreaker" and "The Hill Stiller", but none feel right yet.

In Nasha Town (6.0) a bump against corrugated iron made her want to rework the instrument's own timbre. She plans more compression and a second sound hole for a sharper, more metallic low end. She shields it from rain and yelps "Not the guitar!" when hit.

5.comment: Xinyan: The Vision on Mt. Tianheng
5.content: Xinyan never fit in at Liyue Harbor until she found rock. At first her shows drew jeers, and she broke instruments and played until her hands callused. Sitting on Mt. Tianheng above the harbour lights, she considered leaving for somewhere that appreciated rock, then rejected it as running away and a betrayal of rock's spirit of resistance. She chose to become a flame that would light up the harbour. She practised pyrotechnic playing there daily, burning her fingers and blowing up instruments, until a "boiling-hot" Pyro Vision completed the act. She ran down the mountain and gave her first concert. She reasons that the gods gave her the Vision, so they must like her style.

6.content: The Iridescence Tour is a Fontaine-born music tour meant to involve all seven nations. Xinyan signed up and sailed to Inazuma (2.2, Labyrinth Warriors), only for the organisers to cancel while she was there, leaving her travel permit about to expire. It was cancelled on her again before 2.8. At Lantern Rite 3.4 (The Exquisite Night Chimes) she met the organiser Dvorak in Liyue Harbor and talked him into a Lantern Rite concert. She lined up local talent including Yun Jin, and claimed the opening act for herself. She and Hu Tao opened the Iridescence Tour: Lantern Rite Grand Concert, after rehearsing at the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor and briefing the Yuheng on the pyrotechnics. All of this happened in limited-time events.

7.comment: Xinyan: Labyrinth Warriors and Shiki Taishou
7.content: Stuck in Inazuma with an expiring permit, Xinyan asked the Adventurers' Guild for help and waited outside the Tenryou Commission. Kujou Sara agreed to sort out the permit in exchange for help with a Domain near Araumi spewing monsters. Xinyan offered to cover expenses. At the Domain they found the amnesiac paper shikigami Shiki Taishou. While others were wary, Xinyan "tested" him with a song and trusted him because of his answer. Inside they met Childe, whom Paimon passed off as a Mondstadt adventurer. Xinyan defended Taishou when others suspected him, explaining that being misjudged at a glance is something she knows well. She vowed to write a song about the trip. This was a limited-time event.

8.comment: Xinyan: Summertime Odyssey and the musical island
8.content:
In the 2.8 limited event, Xinyan and Kazuha were travelling together and joined the Traveler, Mona and Fischl on the Golden Apple Archipelago. Mirages drawn from people's memories were appearing on the islands, and the group suspected a strange machine at an abandoned Fatui camp. On the Broken Isle, Xinyan's mirage replayed her childhood and the neighbours' nagging, which she defused with tact. She told Kazuha that rock is not for winning arguments but a revolution made through art. The mirage ended in her house, where Xiangling and Yun Jin threw her a surprise party. Her birthday wish was "to perform with someone completely unexpected." She realised the island itself was a giant instrument built by an unknown ancient musician. After the party cleared its water veins, she played a non-rock duet with that long-gone musician at high tide.

She cooked the camp's seafood barbecue, and in a Mondstadt tavern she laughed at the "Tone-Deaf Bard" Venti's stage name and later at Kazuha, who passed out after drinking what he thought was fruit juice. She called a song "the gift one gives to their kindred spirit".

9.comment: Xinyan: Zhongli, Hu Tao and the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor
9.content:
When almost no one would hear her music, Zhongli invited Xinyan to perform at "his place". She accepted happily and only on arrival learned it was the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, where he is consultant. She still calls him a weird guy. Hu Tao, the parlour's director, always greets her cheerily, saying she likes people who play with fire because they are "good for business". Xinyan finds her bizarre.

In 3.4 (limited) Xinyan rehearsed with Hu Tao at the parlour for the Iridescence Tour concert. She said it took days to get used to Hu Tao's way of talking, and that Zhongli had been the first to invite her there. The two opened the concert together.

10.content: Xinyan met the wandering samurai at a Crux party where she ran the music. She admires that "even a leaf becomes an instrument" in his hands. They travelled from Liyue through Stone Gate into Mondstadt and on to the Golden Apple Archipelago (2.8 limited event). She teased that he acts mature but is still a youngster eager for new experiences. After her mirage, Kazuha said he was developing an interest in rock 'n' roll and its power to build will; she made sure he wasn't joking.

11.content: Chongyun avoids her shows because the heat gets to him, but he once climbed onstage and sang his heart out after a friend brought him to a show. Xingqiu sighs that no spot from Chihu Rock to Yujing Terrace escapes her "disruptive presence". Keqing says her music is noisy by traditional standards but rocks, and good music should reach everyone. Baizhu's prescriptions protect her voice; his snake Changsheng fainted at her thank-you performance and now hides up his sleeve. Gaming says Man Chai goes wild for her music and wants a "Roaring Beasts" rock-and-wushou show with her. Yanfei, after seeing a show, decided that if she ever needs a new career she will be a rapper.

12.content:
In the 6.0 Anecdote "Xinyan: A New Performance", the Traveler finds Xinyan at the Flagship tavern's jukebox in Nasha Town. Her songs felt stale, so she took a holiday to escape "this prison I've built for myself". On her last stop, Fontaine, a magazine with photos of Nod-Krai had caught her eye. She is interested in local folk music and the Frostmoon Scions' unusual instruments, and wants to add flutes, keys and odd phrasing without losing rock's core themes. She also plans to rework her guitar's timbre. She promised the Traveler an invitation to the unveiling of her new sound.

Her October 2025 birthday mail continues the thread. Still blocked, she tried diving on someone's advice, found the underwater world far busier than expected, and now dreams of an underwater rock show despite her fire. Whether either plan came off is not shown by 7.1.
